gloss: to make use of, to put to good use

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {活|い}かしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to make use of, to put to good use, to leverage
definitions.explanation: To effectively use skills, experience, resources, or qualities to achieve something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活|い}かす。
examples.english: To make use of one's experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特長|とくちょう}→特長：00461_tokuchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活|い}かせる⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}したい→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to find a job where I can make use of my strengths.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧につけた⟦{語学力|ごがくりょく}→語学力：29443_gogakuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{活|い}かしたい。
examples.english: I want to put the language skills I acquired through studying abroad to use in my work.

notes:
{活|い}かす means to effectively utilize something valuable.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活|い}かす

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活|い}かす: to make use of experience
- ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活|い}かす: to leverage one's abilities
- ⟦{特長|とくちょう}→特長：00461_tokuchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活|い}かす: to put one's strengths to use
- ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活|い}かす: to utilize resources

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {活|い}かす: to put to good use (implies effective utilization)
- ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use (general, neutral)
- ⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to utilize (formal, broader scope)
